anchors.anchor: A moment later, we’re in my bedroom.
A dribble leaks out, and I swirl my tongue around his tip.
“Are you sure this is okay?” I ask again.
“More than okay.” He can’t seem to hold still.
What does this mean for Daniel at the Agency?
He doesn’t say he’ll be with me after the end, of course.
We topple together onto the bed in a tangle of limbs.
